standard: docs/RECHECK-RUNNER.md with the 2.34 / 27 Sep grade standard: a grade moves one step at most, a move needs a kit or patch reason plus evidence the same way, a drop without a kit reason needs the whole-line 95% interval to exclude the previous review rate, and a high rate alone never raises a grade. A retained sample is not stamped as a recheck, so no grade entry is touched.
